description: This PHP class 'UnknownPathExcluder' is part of Drupal's package_manager module. It implements event subscription to exclude unknown paths from stage operations based on project configuration, web root, and installed packages. It manages paths like vendor directories, composer files, scaffold files, and custom repositories, and logs excluded paths.

classes.name: UnknownPathExcluder
classes.description: A final class implementing event subscription and path exclusion logic for Drupal's package manager, managing unknown paths based on configuration and project structure.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event classes to handler methods for event subscription.

methods.name: getExcludedPaths
methods.description: Determines and returns a list of paths to exclude from staging, based on project configuration, web root, and installed packages.

methods.name: excludeUnknownPaths
methods.description: Handles the event to add excluded paths to the event object.

methods.name: logExcludedPaths
methods.description: Logs the list of paths that are excluded from staging.

methods.name: getScaffoldFiles
methods.description: Retrieves scaffold file paths provided by Drupal core, relative to the project root.
